constants.armed: If Pi ever reads them they shall never raise coverage, tone or freshness, never surface as values and travel only as bounded receipt-identity refs
constants.acceptance: Acceptance, armed on landing (freeze-and-flip like wb-973.13): a fixture envelope carrying hypothetical GP fields on a clean envelope projects byte-identical except at most one bounded rf-gp:<program>:<checkpoint>:<backend> ref and one note; on a flagged, over-budget, fixture-seam or non-observed envelope it stays partial/unknown (one-directional, mirroring wb-693.3 and wb-973.10); the SECRET- leak walk shows no score numeric, embedding or receipt text in any surfaced string.
constants.untilThen: Until then: a default-gate census asserts git grep GraphPolicy|GraphDataIR|graph-policy over src, test, docs/workbench and qa is empty and the wb-973.11 fixture record carries no such keys.
